params.body:
The pipeline now names its store doors `/store/query|patch|create|delete` (gentells-pipeline#233). This switches the calls in `src/api.js` and `src/hooks/useData.js`, plus the Playwright mocks and the live check.

Merge after gentells-pipeline#233 is deployed. The old `/sanity/*` names keep answering for that one deploy, so the order only matters for the cleanup that follows.

Lint at the ceiling (24), build ok, Playwright 23 of 23.
params.title: Call the store as /store/*
